name: Pixel Card
description: 300x400 card with a canvas of twinkling pixels that reveal outward from the center or pointer on hover, click or always, with spotlight, glow and click pulse. Holds custom children.
contents: Card container with gradient surface, rim highlight and rounded corners
Canvas pixel field behind the children
Children slot rendered above the canvas
behavior: Pixels grow in with an overshoot and twinkle, starting at the origin and spreading outward
Trigger hover, click (toggle, closes on outside click) or always
Pointer spotlight follows the cursor with spring motion and enlarges nearby pixels
Click or tap emits a ripple pulse
Intro reveals once when scrolled into view, then releases unless trigger is always
Animation pauses when offscreen and respects prefers-reduced-motion
Keyboard focus activates in hover mode, Enter or Space toggles in click mode
editableByProps: Color preset, custom pixel colors, glow color, dark or light theme
Pixel gap, size, shape, speed, opacity and edge fade
Trigger mode, reveal origin and duration, intro and delay, click pulse
Spotlight and glow strength, corner radius, card content via children

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[300px] h-[400px] in the CARD constant (or override via className)

needsCodeEdit.change: Change reveal and exit speed of each pixel

fixed: Fixed 300x400 card size unless overridden with className
Content layout inside is a centered grid, children get relative z-index above the canvas
Adds a document-level pointerdown listener while mounted for click-outside close
Client-only, needs canvas, ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver
Pink variant disables focus and tab stop by default
Changing prop values after mount other than trigger is read live, no remount needed

options.look: Fine neutral white or dark gray pixels, gap 5, medium speed
options.useWhen: Neutral feature cards on a dark or minimal page

options.look: Sky blue pixels with wider gap 10 and blue glow
Dense yellow pixels, gap 3, warm glow
options.useWhen: Highlighting a promo or pricing card

options.look: Rose pixels, gap 6, fast twinkle, not focusable by default
options.useWhen: Decorative creative or lifestyle cards that are not interactive
